dedupe_keys.name: seznam parkirisc v obcini mirna pec

description: Seznam parkirišč v Občini Mirna Peč is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA MIRNA PEČ. List of parking lots in the Municipality of Mirna Peč. The collection contains the name of the parking lot, the location coordinate, the chargeability, the number of parking spaces and data on electric charging stations. Coverage: OBČINA MIRNA PEČ. The portal shows the English title as "List of parking lots in the Municipality of Mirna Peč" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA MIRNA PEČ. Its keywords include parkirna mesta, parkirišča. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
